title: Taxonomic Profiling Pipeline with Hostile and Sourmash
description: Pipeline for taxonomic profiling using Sourmash after cleaning reads with Hostile

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Define where the pipeline should find input data and save output data.

input.description: Path to an input CSV file with a required non-empty sample_id column, or a directory containing paired FASTQ files. Optional only when --genome_input is supplied.

outdir.description: The output directory where results will be saved

publish_dir_mode.description: Method used to save pipeline results

assembly_input.description: Path to CSV file containing pre-computed assemblies (optional). Skips preprocessing and assembly steps. Required columns: sample_id, run_id, group, assembler, fasta
assembly_input.help_text: When supplied, only binning and downstream workflows are run. Must be used with --input_format csv. Reads must also be provided via --input parameter

genome_input.description: Standalone genome CSV for bacterial downstream analysis. Required headers: sample_id,fasta. Optional headers: run_id,group,assembler,lineage.
genome_input.help_text: Rows with a valid GTDB-style lineage bypass classification. Rows with blank lineage are classified through BIN_CLASSIFICATION and need its database inputs (--sourmash_database and --sourmash_taxonomy_csv, or --bin_classifier gtdbtk with --gtdbtk_db). This input is mutually exclusive with --input and --assembly_input.

pipeline_root.description: Internal repository-root override for focused workflow tests.

database_options.title: Database options
database_options.description: Reference database options required for taxonomic profiling

sourmash_database.description: Sourmash database(s): one .rocksdb/.zip, or several zip/sig databases separated by commas
sourmash_database.help_text: Required for bin classification, read-based profiling, and --genome_input rows whose lineage field is blank. Example: --sourmash_database "path/to/db1.zip,path/to/db2.zip". Several RocksDB indexes cannot be combined (fastmultigather skips them in a pathlist). With several databases YACHT is skipped, because YACHT takes one database.

sourmash_taxonomy_csv.description: Sourmash taxonomy lineages CSV/sqldb; several files separated by commas
sourmash_taxonomy_csv.help_text: Required when running workflows that use SOURMASH_TAXANNOTATE (READ_BASED, READ_BASED_SINGLERUN, BIN_CLASSIFICATION), including --genome_input rows whose lineage field is blank. Give one taxonomy file per database when the databases come from different sources.

yacht_database.description: Path to YACHT database configuration file
yacht_database.help_text: Required only if using read-based profiling workflow

amrfinderplus_db.description: AMRFinderPlus 4.x database directory (a dated version folder or its latest link).
amrfinderplus_db.help_text: Optional. When unset, amrfinder_update downloads the current database into the run work directory. A database made for AMRFinderPlus 3.x is not compatible.

save_amrfinderplus_db.description: Save the downloaded AMRFinderPlus database to <outdir>/Databases/AMRFinderPlus.
save_amrfinderplus_db.help_text: Used only when the pipeline downloads it (no local path given). Pass the saved folder on later runs to skip the download; set false to keep it only in the work directory.

amrfinderplus_args.help_text: Default --plus as in 5_amr.sh. Replaces the default when set, so keep --plus if you want it. --organism is added per genome from --amrfinderplus_organism_map.

amrfinderplus_organism_map.description: TSV mapping GTDB lineage to AMRFinderPlus --organism.
amrfinderplus_organism_map.help_text: Columns lineage_pattern, organism. The first row whose lineage_pattern occurs in the genome lineage wins; no match = no --organism. GTDB suffixes such as _B are ignored when matching (s__Enterococcus_B faecium matches s__Enterococcus faecium). Default: assets/amrfinderplus_organisms.tsv (the 5_amr.sh list).

abricate_db.description: Optional read-only custom ABRicate data directory.
abricate_db.help_text: Leave unset to use the database bundled with the installed ABRicate container. When set, the directory must contain --abricate_db_id.

abricate_db_version.description: Explicit ABRicate database version label recorded by hAMRonization.

abricate_args.description: Additional arguments appended to ABRicate after the configured --db value.

rgi_load_args.description: Additional arguments appended to rgi load.

rgi_main_args.help_text: Default as in 5_amr.sh. --input_type contig and --local are always added.

resfinder_db.help_text: Optional. When resfinder_db, pointfinder_db or disinfinder_db is unset, the missing ones are downloaded at tag resfinder-4.7.2 into the run work directory.

save_resfinder_db.description: Save the downloaded ResFinder, PointFinder and DisinFinder databases to <outdir>/Databases/ResFinder.
save_resfinder_db.help_text: Used only when the pipeline downloads it (no local path given). Pass the saved folder on later runs to skip the download; set false to keep it only in the work directory.

resfinder_args.help_text: Default as in 5_amr.sh. --point --species is added when the genome species or genus has a PointFinder folder.

resfinder_db_revision.description: CGE git tag/commit downloaded for resfinder_db, pointfinder_db and disinfinder_db when they are not supplied.

pointfinder_db.help_text: Optional; downloaded when unset. PointFinder runs when the genome species (else genus) has a folder in this database, as in 5_amr.sh.

disinfinder_db.help_text: Optional; downloaded at tag resfinder-4.7.2 when unset.

deeparg_db.description: DeepARG data folder (contains database/ and model/).
deeparg_db.help_text: Optional. When unset, deeparg download_data fetches it into the run work directory (about 1 GB, slow).

save_deeparg_db.description: Save the downloaded DeepARG data folder to <outdir>/Databases/DeepARG.
save_deeparg_db.help_text: Used only when the pipeline downloads it (no local path given). Pass the saved folder on later runs to skip the download; set false to keep it only in the work directory.

deeparg_db_version.description: DeepARG database version recorded by hAMRonization.

deeparg_args.description: Additional arguments appended to DeepARG predict.

deeparg_model.description: DeepARG model: SS (short sequences, 5_amr.sh) or LS (long sequences, e.g. predicted genes).

virulencefinder_db.description: VirulenceFinder database directory (must contain config and notes.txt).
virulencefinder_db.help_text: Optional. When unset, virulencefinder_db is downloaded at a fixed revision into the run work directory.

save_virulencefinder_db.description: Save the downloaded VirulenceFinder database to <outdir>/Databases/VirulenceFinder.
save_virulencefinder_db.help_text: Used only when the pipeline downloads it (no local path given). Pass the saved folder on later runs to skip the download; set false to keep it only in the work directory.

virulencefinder_db_revision.description: virulencefinder_db commit/tag downloaded when --virulencefinder_db is not set (065b8d1 = virulencefinder-3.2.1).

mlst_args.description: Additional arguments appended to MLST (e.g. --scheme klebsiella).

kleborate_preset_map.description: TSV mapping GTDB lineage to a Kleborate v3 preset and module list.
kleborate_preset_map.help_text: Columns lineage_pattern, preset (may be empty), modules. The first row whose lineage_pattern occurs in the genome lineage wins; genomes with no match skip Kleborate. GTDB suffixes such as _B are ignored when matching (s__Enterococcus_B faecium matches s__Enterococcus faecium). Default: assets/kleborate_presets.tsv (the 3_kleb.sh rules).

bacterial_decision_table.description: TSV of per-lineage y/n decisions for the bacterial downstream steps.
bacterial_decision_table.help_text: Optional: without it every d__Bacteria genome follows the default route. Columns: lineage_pattern, optional label, then any of amrfinderplus, abricate, rgi, resfinder, deeparg, mlst, virulencefinder, plasmidfinder, kleborate, sistr, seqsero2, genotyphi, paratype with y or n. lineage_pattern is one or more whole GTDB taxa at any rank (p__Bacillota, g__Salmonella, s__Escherichia coli; GTDB suffixes such as _B are ignored). The most specific matching row decides its y/n steps (species over genus over phylum, whatever the row order); blank cells, missing columns and lineages with no row follow the default route. --skip_<tool> still turns a tool off for every genome. kleborate=y also needs a --kleborate_preset_map row; genotyphi/paratype=y still need the SISTR serovar route. Optional parameter columns, per genome of the matched row: amrfinderplus_args, abricate_args, rgi_main_args, resfinder_args, deeparg_args, mlst_args, virulencefinder_args, plasmidfinder_args, kleborate_args, sistr_args, seqsero2_args, mykrobe_args, paratype_args (a non-blank cell replaces the --<column> parameter, e.g. mlst_args '--scheme ecoli_achtman_4'), amrfinderplus_organism (replaces the --amrfinderplus_organism_map value) and resfinder_species (PointFinder species folder, e.g. escherichia_coli). Example: assets/bacterial_decision_table_example.tsv.

seqsero2_args.help_text: Default as in 4_sal.sh (k-mer mode, assembly input).

mykrobe_args.description: Additional arguments appended to Mykrobe predict.

paratype_bundle.help_text: Used only for genomes whose SISTR serovar is Paratyphi A. If not set, Paratype is cloned at a fixed commit when such a genome is found. The directory must contain paratype.py, SParatyphiAKU12601.fasta, SParatyphiA_genotype_specific_alleles.txt and SParatyphiA_gene_mutation_codons.txt; it is copied into each task and never modified.

save_paratype_db.description: Save the downloaded Paratype checkout to <outdir>/Databases/ParaType.
save_paratype_db.help_text: Used only when the pipeline downloads it (no local path given). Pass the saved folder on later runs to skip the download; set false to keep it only in the work directory.

paratype_revision.description: Paratype (github.com/CHRF-Genomics/Paratype) commit cloned when --paratype_bundle is not set.

preprocessing_options.title: Preprocessing options
preprocessing_options.description: Options for quality control and host removal

skip_preprocess.description: Skip the entire preprocessing workflow (QC and host removal)
skip_preprocess.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline will use input reads directly for downstream analysis, bypassing Fastp and Hostile steps

hostile_index.description: Name of the Hostile index to use

hostile_ref_name.description: Reference name for Hostile (defaults to hostile_index if not set)

fastp_adapter_fasta.description: Path to adapter FASTA file for Fastp

workflow_options.title: Workflow options
workflow_options.description: Options controlling which workflows to run

enable_readbase.description: Run the read-based profiling subworkflow instead of assembly-based

enable_singlesketch.description: Enable per-sample processing mode using SOURMASH_SKETCH and SOURMASH_GATHER instead of batch processing with SOURMASH_MANYSKETCH and SOURMASH_FASTMULTIGATHER. Useful for HPC environments where per-sample job control is needed.

enable_bacterial_downstream.description: Route assembly-produced bins with resolved d__Bacteria lineage into bacterial downstream analysis.
enable_bacterial_downstream.help_text: This switch is for the ordinary assembly/binning route. Supplying --genome_input activates the same downstream routing contract automatically.

readbased_taxotools.description: Read-based profiler(s): microcosm (sourmash + YACHT), sylph, or microcosm,sylph
readbased_taxotools.help_text: sylph profiles the paired reads directly (no read merging) and writes to Readbased_Analysis/sylph/. With both, each tool keeps its own output folder. --enable_singlesketch only changes the microcosm branch.

readbased_postprocess.description: Optional post-processing mode for merged read-based Sourmash-YACHT results. Requires enable_readbase. The all mode creates default, phyloseq, and taxburst outputs and also collects RGI-BWT outputs when enable_rgi_bwt is enabled.
readbased_postprocess.help_text: Valid values: all, phyloseq, taxburst, rgi_bwt. The rgi_bwt mode requires --enable_rgi_bwt. With all and RGI-BWT disabled, only the RGI-BWT output is skipped and the pipeline continues with a warning.

readbased_postprocess_options.description: Additional supported command-line options passed safely to bin/py_scripts/read_based/post_processing.py. Defaults to filtering YACHT results at min_coverage 0.05.
readbased_postprocess_options.help_text: Default: --min_coverage 0.05. Override this string to use another supported threshold or option, such as --min_coverage 0.1 --use_average. Module-managed input, input_format, output, and output_format arguments cannot be overridden. Options must be compatible with every selected output mode (--remove_unclassified is not passed to taxburst, which already leaves unclassified out). The microcosm MultiQC section follows the same --min_coverage and --remove_unclassified (Unclassified left out, taxa rescaled to 100 %).

enable_rgi_bwt.description: Enable RGI BWT analysis for antimicrobial resistance genes

megahit_options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to MEGAHIT

spades_options.description: Additional command-line options to pass to SPAdes

megahit_fix_cpu_1.description: Force MEGAHIT to use a single CPU

spades_fix_cpus.description: Set a fixed number of CPUs for SPAdes when >= 0

skip_contig_analysis.description: Skip the entire contig analysis subworkflow

save_contig_annotations.description: Save gene annotations in results directory

genomad_splits.description: Number of splits for geNomad processing

skip_tiara_contigqc.description: Skip TIARA domain classification for contigs

tiara_min_length.description: Minimum contig length for TIARA classification

genomad_e2e_options.description: Additional command-line options for geNomad end-to-end analysis

skip_binning_bamabund.description: Skip mapping reads to assemblies for binning

save_assembly_mapped_reads.description: Save BAM and BAI files from read mapping

exclude_unbins_from_postbinning.description: Exclude unbinned contigs from post-binning QC, taxonomic classification, and annotation steps

min_length_unbinned_contigs.description: Minimum length for splitting unbinned contigs

max_unbinned_contigs.description: Maximum number of unbinned contigs to split

binning_refinement_options.title: Binning refinement options
binning_refinement_options.description: Options for refining bins using DAS Tool or Binette

checkm2_db.description: Path to CheckM2 database (optional; will be downloaded if needed for Binette or CheckM2 Bin QC)
checkm2_db.help_text: If omitted and binqc_tool=checkm2 or refine_tool=binette, the pipeline downloads and configures the CheckM2 database.

postbinning_input.description: Which bins to use for downstream analysis

bin_domain_classification_options.title: Bin domain classification options
bin_domain_classification_options.description: Options for classifying bins by domain

binqc_tool.description: Tool(s) for bin quality assessment: busco, checkm, checkm2, or several comma-separated (e.g. checkm2,checkm)

checkm2_db_version.description: Zenodo record ID for CheckM2 database

prokka_bins_compliance_centre.description: Sequencing centre ID for Prokka compliance mode

prokka_bins_with_compliance.description: Turn on Prokka compliance mode for bin annotation and NCBI/ENA-compatible contig names

annotation_bakta_singlemode.description: Use Bakta's genome-length optimized mode instead of metagenome mode

annotation_bakta_complete.description: Treat all sequences as complete replicons

annotation_bakta_renamecontigheaders.description: Rewrite the original contig headers in Bakta output

annotation_bakta_compliant.description: Clean Bakta annotations to standardize them to GenBank/ENA/DDBJ conventions

annotation_bakta_trna.description: Activate Bakta tRNA detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_tmrna.description: Activate Bakta tmRNA detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_rrna.description: Activate Bakta rRNA detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_ncrna.description: Activate Bakta ncRNA detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_ncrnaregion.description: Activate Bakta ncRNA region detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_crispr.description: Activate Bakta CRISPR array detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_skipcds.description: Skip Bakta CDS detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_pseudo.description: Activate Bakta pseudogene detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_skipsorf.description: Skip Bakta sORF detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_gap.description: Activate Bakta gap detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_ori.description: Activate Bakta oriC/oriT detection and annotation

annotation_bakta_activate_plot.description: Activate generation of Bakta circular genome plots

bin_classification_options.title: Bin classification options
bin_classification_options.description: Options for taxonomic classification of bins

bin_classifier.help_text: sourmash sketches the bins and runs gather + tax genome against --sourmash_database / --sourmash_taxonomy_csv. gtdbtk runs GTDB-Tk classify_wf against --gtdbtk_db instead (one call per sample; --genome_input rows without lineage in one call). Both give GTDB lineages to the bacterial downstream routing, --bacterial_decision_table and MultiQC; GTDB-Tk 'Unclassified Bacteria' bins (too few markers) are routed as d__Bacteria, plain 'Unclassified' and failed bins as unresolved. Results: Taxonomy/sourmash/ or Taxonomy/GTDB-Tk/.

gtdbtk_db.description: GTDB-Tk reference data directory (needed with --bin_classifier gtdbtk)
gtdbtk_db.help_text: Unpacked GTDB-Tk reference data for GTDB-Tk 2.5.2 (GTDB release226; read only), e.g. --gtdbtk_db /path/to/gtdb/release226 (the folder that contains metadata/, markers/, skani/ ...).

gtdbtk_args.help_text: Added after --extension and --pplacer_cpus, e.g. '--min_perc_aa 10 --min_af 0.65' (GTDB-Tk defaults) or '--skip_ani_screen'.

gtdbtk_pplacer_cpus.description: CPUs for pplacer inside GTDB-Tk (its memory grows with each CPU)

gtdbtk_pplacer_scratch.description: Let pplacer use a scratch folder (lower memory, more disk I/O)

sourmash_thresholdbp.description: Threshold in base pairs for Sourmash gather

enable_copysketch.description: Save batch sketch files to output

enable_copysketch_singles.description: Save individual single sketch files to output

skip_yacht.description: Skip YACHT-based filtering and read-based results processing
skip_yacht.help_text: When enabled, the pipeline will skip YACHT analysis

sylph_datatype.description: sylph value used for the merged sylph-tax table and the phyloseq otu_table
sylph_datatype.help_text: taxonomic_abundance uses sylph-tax relative_abundance; sequence_abundance runs sylph profile with --estimate-read-counts and uses the estimated read counts.

enable_sylphtax.description: Run sylph-tax taxprof on the sylph profiles (needs --sylph_taxonomy)
enable_sylphtax.help_text: Writes per-sample *.sylphmpa, a merged clade x sample table, and with --readbased_postprocess phyloseq/all the phyloseq tables (tax_table.csv, otu_table.csv, sample_data.csv).

sylph_taxonomy.description: sylph-tax metadata file(s) matching the sylph database(s), comma-separated
sylph_taxonomy.help_text: One metadata file per sylph database (the pipeline stops when the counts differ), all passed to one sylph-tax taxprof call (-t). Example for --sylph_database gtdb-r226-c200-dbv2.syl2db,fungi-refseq-2025-10-11-c200-dbv1.syldb: --sylph_taxonomy gtdb_r226_metadata.tsv.gz,fungi_refseq_2025-10-11_metadata.tsv.gz.

yacht_ksize.description: k-mer size for YACHT analysis (must match sourmash_ksize when using both)
yacht_ksize.help_text: This value should be consistent with sourmash_ksize to ensure compatibility between Sourmash and YACHT workflows

bacterial_downstream_skip_options.title: Bacterial downstream tool switches
bacterial_downstream_skip_options.description: Turn off single tools of the bacterial downstream analysis (--genome_input or --enable_bacterial_downstream).

skip_mlst.description: Skip MLST in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_virulencefinder.description: Skip VirulenceFinder in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_plasmidfinder.description: Skip PlasmidFinder in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_kleborate.description: Skip Kleborate in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_sistr.description: Skip SISTR (also stops GenoTyphi and Paratype, which are routed by the SISTR serovar) in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_seqsero2.description: Skip SeqSero2 in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_genotyphi.description: Skip Mykrobe + GenoTyphi for SISTR Typhi genomes in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_paratype.description: Skip Paratype for SISTR Paratyphi A genomes in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_amrfinderplus.description: Skip AMRFinderPlus in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_abricate.description: Skip ABRicate in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_rgi.description: Skip RGI in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_resfinder.description: Skip ResFinder/PointFinder/DisinFinder in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_deeparg.description: Skip DeepARG in the bacterial downstream analysis.

skip_argnorm.description: Skip ARGnorm in the bacterial downstream analysis.

rgi_options.title: RGI options
rgi_options.description: Options for antimicrobial resistance gene identification

rgi_include_wildcard.help_text: When a bacterial-genome RGI database is supplied, WildCARD files are required only when this option is enabled.

rgi_include_other_models.description: Include other model types in RGI

rgi_bwt_prefix.description: Custom prefix for RGI bwt outputs

rgi_preparecarddb_dir.help_text: Optional. When unset, CARD (and WildCARD) is downloaded and prepared once per run (see --save_rgi_db). When supplied, validation requires card.json and processed card_database files; WildCARD files are also required when --rgi_include_wildcard is enabled.

save_rgi_db.description: Save the downloaded CARD database prepared by RGI to <outdir>/Databases/RGI.
save_rgi_db.help_text: Used only when the pipeline downloads it (no local path given). Pass the saved folder on later runs to skip the download; set false to keep it only in the work directory.

annotation_pyrodigal_closed.description: Disallow partial genes on contig edges

annotation_pyrodigal_usespecialstopchara.description: Force Pyrodigal to append asterisks as stop codon indicators

annotation_prokka_compliant.description: Force Genbank/ENA/DDJB compliance for Prokka annotation

annotation_prokka_singlemode.description: Use Prokka's genome-length optimized mode instead of metagenome mode

annotation_prokka_coverage.description: Minimum coverage percentage for Prokka annotation

annotation_prokka_evalue.description: E-value cut-off for Prokka similarity searches

annotation_prokka_cdsrnaolap.description: Allow transfer RNA features to overlap coding sequences in Prokka annotation

annotation_prokka_rawproduct.description: Suppress Prokka's default clean-up of gene annotation products

annotation_prokka_rnammer.description: Use RNAmmer for Prokka rRNA prediction

annotation_prokka_addgenes.description: Add gene features for each Prokka CDS hit

annotation_prokka_retaincontigheaders.description: Retain the input contig names in Prokka output

skip_multiqc.help_text: Sections: microcosm top taxa (tab per rank; needs --readbased_postprocess all), sylph profile, sylph-tax (--enable_sylphtax), bacterial genome overview, Kleborate, Salmonella typing, FastQC/fastp, bin QC (CheckM2, CheckM, BUSCO, QUAST), Prokka, run summary and software versions. Styled by assets/multiqc_config.yml and assets/microcosm_logo.png.

cleanup.description: Clean up intermediate files after completion

cleanup_patterns.description: List of file/directory patterns to clean up when cleanup is enabled

help.description: Show the concise pipeline help message and exit.

help_full.description: Show the full pipeline help message, including hidden parameters, and exit.

show_hidden.description: Include hidden parameters when rendering the help message.

trace_report_suffix.description: Suffix to add to the trace report filename. Default is the date and time in the format yyyy-MM-dd_HH-mm-ss.

resource_options.title: Resource options
resource_options.description: Global and profile-specific resource allocation limits

max_cpus.description: Maximum number of CPUs that can be requested for any process

max_memory.description: Maximum memory allocation that can be requested for any process

max_time.description: Maximum time limit that can be requested for any process
